*   **When to use:** When rendering quadratic SDF primitives (ellipsoids, ellipsoidal blobs) with strict error bounds.

The method originates from multiresolution modeling for scientific visualization, specifically in the context of approximating quadratic surfaces for volume rendering.

The approach leverages the rotational symmetry of the canonical paraboloid to define an optimal equilateral triangle, then maps this triangle to the general elliptic case via principal axis transformation.
